comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rack rail; record seats a sleeve while registering its radial oil port.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate handles and latches a long articulated rail at four holes, then fastens it; record performs precise coaxial insertion while preserving hidden rotational port alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks post retention, level rack units, screws, and support; record checks submillimetric seating, ≤1° tilt, an unobstructed gauge path, release, low motion, and 1 s persistence.
comparison.reason: Both involve alignment during insertion, but radial fluid-passage registration is a meaningfully different tested ability from rack-post latching. Candidate lacks comparably numeric pose, obstruction, and force tolerances.
